I2VA:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Soft anime cel-shaded illustration look with clean line art, a pastel palette and even daylight on a plain pale cream background. A static medium shot: on the left, a girl with long wavy ash-blonde hair and straight bangs wearing a teal off-shoulder top, smiling openly with her mouth open and a faint blush; on the right, a smaller girl with waist-length silver-white hair, large furry cat ears with pale pink inner fur, amber-gold eyes and a black sleeveless lace top, sitting with her knees drawn up. Their hands are already clasped together between them. The blonde girl leans forward and pulls gently; the silver-haired girl unfolds her legs, both plant their bare feet on the floor, and they rise together to standing side by side, their joined hands swinging lightly between them as their weight shifts forward. Her long hair, teal sleeves and the lace hem sway with the motion, and the cat ears wobble once before settling upright.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the camera cuts to a wider, slightly low-angle view as both girls break into a run straight toward the lens, hands still clasped between them. A steady dolly back keeps them framed as they grow rapidly larger, hair, cat ears, sleeves and hems streaming backward, the blonde girl laughing with her mouth open and the silver-haired girl smiling softly, their bare feet landing in alternating light strides until they fill most of the frame and reach the lens.

overall_soundscape: Quiet indoor room tone with a soft airy hush. Fabric rustles as both girls push up from the floor, bare feet make light quick taps, and the clasped hands make a small soft slap on contact. The blonde girl gives a short bright laugh as she pulls her companion up, and the silver-haired girl answers with a small breathy giggle that carries into the run. No other voices.

non_diegetic_music: A light acoustic arrangement with plucked strings, a warm upright bass and a soft hand-clap rhythm at a moderate tempo. The instrumentation stays sparse and bright, entering quietly and swelling slightly as the girls break into the run.
